name: Sandbag library (bag meshes)
description: HB1b: four sandbag meshes from the user's Sandbag Wall model, decimated to ~420 triangles (LOD1 ~130). Every sandbag box part (hessian / sandbag materials) of every asset draws one of these, instanced (src/sandbags.cpp); the box stays the collider. Tinted toward hessian tan in the bake (matOverride base 1.3 / 1.5 / 1.45: the model's albedo is a red-brown).
